definition.simple: A smart guess that you can test to see if it's true.
definition.academic: A proposed explanation for a phenomenon, made as a starting point for further investigation and experimentation.

examples: Guessing that adding salt to water will make it boil faster, then testing it.
Predicting that a heavier ball falls faster than a lighter one.

common_misconceptions: A hypothesis is a proven fact (No, it is just an educated guess that needs testing).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to form a hypothesis about why the sky is blue before explaining the real reason.
